Summary: Master / Tenant Governance
Description: Manage the institute/tenant master registry, the authoritative college registry under each institute, and tenant onboarding/activation/suspension provisioning state, as owned by ADM01_institutes, ADM01_colleges and ADM01_tenant_provisioning.

Summary: Register a new institute (tenant) on the platform
Description: As a Super Admin, I want to create a new institute/tenant master record so that the institute can be onboarded onto CampXSync as an authoritative, uniquely identified tenant.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a valid instituteCode, legalName, displayName, timezone, locale and defaultCurrency, when I submit POST /api/v1/admin/institutes, then a new ADM01_institutes document is created with status ACTIVE and version 1 | Given an instituteCode that already exists for the tenant, when I submit the create request, then it is rejected with a uniqueness-violation error and no record is written | Given the institute is created successfully, then an InstitutesCreated event is published on the outbox and the response includes the resource representation plus correlation metadata

Summary: Update institute profile while protecting published identity keys
Description: As a Super Admin, I want to update non-identity institute attributes (status, locale, currentConfigVersion, etc.) so that institute records stay current without compromising already-published identity keys.
Acceptance Criteria: Given an existing institute, when I submit PUT /api/v1/admin/institutes/{id} changing displayName/timezone/locale/status, then the update succeeds and an InstitutesUpdated event is emitted | Given a request attempts to change the immutable published identity key (instituteCode/tenantId), when the update is submitted, then it is rejected | Given status is set to INACTIVE, then only ACTIVE/INACTIVE values are accepted and the change is optimistic-concurrency checked against the current version

Summary: List and search institutes
Description: As a Super Admin, I want to list and filter institutes by status and recency so that I can monitor the tenant base and locate a specific institute quickly.
Acceptance Criteria: Given institutes exist, when I call GET /api/v1/admin/institutes with status and updatedAt filters, then results are returned ordered using the (status,updatedAt) index | Given no filters are supplied, then all institutes visible to my tenant scope are returned paginated

Summary: Register a college under an institute
Description: As an Institute Admin, I want to create a college record under my institute so that the college becomes an authoritative, provisionable tenant entity.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a collegeCode, name and campusIds, when I create a college, then the parent institute must exist and be resolvable or the request is rejected | Given the collegeCode already exists within the tenant, then creation is rejected as a uniqueness violation | Given the college is created, then a CollegesCreated event is published and the college is indexed by (instituteId,status)

Summary: Prevent provisioning against an inactive college
Description: As an Institute Admin, I want inactive colleges to be blocked from receiving new provisioning so that deactivated colleges cannot silently gain new tenant context.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a college with status INACTIVE, when a new provisioning request targets that college, then the request is rejected with a clear lifecycle-state error | Given the college is reactivated to ACTIVE, then subsequent provisioning requests are accepted normally

Summary: Provision a tenant/college context end-to-end
Description: As a Super Admin, I want to submit a tenant provisioning request so that a new institute/college scope is created, approved where required, and activated with full traceability.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a valid targetScope and planId, when I POST /api/v1/admin/tenants/{id}/provision, then a ADM01_tenant_provisioning record is created with provisioningStatus REQUESTED and requestedAt/requestedBy captured | Given the state machine, when a status transition is attempted that is not a valid next state, then it is rejected | Given the same provisioning request is resubmitted with the same idempotency key, when the request is processed, then no duplicate provisioning record is created | Given provisioning completes, then a TenantProvisioned event is published and downstream services can consume it to create local context

Summary: Track and audit tenant provisioning status
Description: As Platform Ops, I want to query provisioning records by tenant and status so that I can monitor onboarding progress and investigate stalled requests.
Acceptance Criteria: Given provisioning records exist, when I query by (tenantId,provisioningStatus), then matching records are returned using the compound index | Given a request is older than an operational SLA threshold and still not completed, then it is visible for escalation via requestedAt ordering

Summary: Configuration & Policy
Description: Manage platform-wide configuration values, feature flags, governance policies and immutable configuration version snapshots as owned by ADM01_global_settings, ADM01_feature_flags, ADM01_global_policies and ADM01_configuration_versions.

Summary: Define and update a global platform configuration setting
Description: As a Super Admin, I want to create or update a scoped global setting with an effective date range so that platform behavior can be governed consistently across tenants.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a key, value, dataType and scope, when I create a setting, then it is stored uniquely per (scope,key,version) and becomes effective per effectiveFrom | Given the value represents a secret, when it is submitted as plaintext, then the request is rejected and only a secret reference is accepted | Given the setting is updated, then the previous version is preserved and the new version is indexed by (status,effectiveFrom)

Summary: View effective global configuration
Description: As an Institute Admin, I want to retrieve the currently effective global configuration so that I understand the rules my institute currently operates under.
Acceptance Criteria: Given multiple versions of a setting exist, when I call GET /api/v1/admin/configuration, then only the version whose effectiveFrom/effectiveTo window includes now is returned | Given no active version exists for a key, then the response indicates no effective value rather than an error

Summary: Roll out a feature flag with tenant overrides and a kill switch
Description: As a Super Admin, I want to create and manage a feature flag with targeting rules and per-tenant overrides so that features can be safely rolled out or disabled platform-wide.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a flagKey, defaultValue and targetingRules, when I create the flag, then flagKey is enforced unique and invalid targeting rules are rejected at validation time | Given a tenant override is added, then it is indexed by tenantOverrides.tenantId and takes precedence over defaultValue for that tenant | Given any flag change, then the change is captured in the audit trail and a Feature FlagsChanged event is published

Summary: Publish an immutable governance policy
Description: As a Super Admin, I want to author and publish a global governance policy version so that platform-wide rules are enforced consistently and cannot be silently altered after publication.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a draft policy with policyCode, policyType and rules, when I publish it, then the (policyCode,version) becomes immutable and further edits require a new version | Given a policy requires approval, then approvedBy must be recorded before the policy transitions to published status | Given the policy is published, then a Global PoliciesCreated/Updated event is emitted for downstream policy evaluation

Summary: Snapshot and roll back configuration via immutable version records
Description: As a Super Admin, I want every configuration change captured as an immutable, checksummed snapshot so that I can audit history and roll back to a known-good configuration state.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a configuration change is persisted, when the transaction commits, then a corresponding ADM01_configuration_versions snapshot is written with a unique (scope,version) and checksum | Given a snapshot exists, when a modification to that snapshot is attempted, then it is rejected because snapshots are immutable | Given a rollback is requested, when an authorized admin activates a prior version, then the activation itself is authorized and audited, not performed silently

Summary: Identity, Role & Access
Description: Manage platform administrative user context, RBAC roles, the fine-grained permission catalog, role bindings, and periodic access reviews as owned by ADM01_admin_users, ADM01_roles, ADM01_permissions, ADM01_role_bindings and ADM01_access_reviews.

Summary: Register and monitor a platform administrative user's status
Description: As a Security Admin, I want to track administrative user status and risk state without storing credentials so that I can manage administrative accounts safely alongside centralized IAM.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a userId resolved through IAM, when an admin-user record is created, then no password or credential material is stored locally | Given the user's identity reference cannot be resolved through IAM, then the create/update request is rejected | Given status or riskState changes, then the record is updated and indexed by (status,lastLoginAt) and an Admin UsersUpdated event is published

Summary: Define a platform role with a permission bundle
Description: As a Security Admin, I want to create and version platform roles with bundled permissions so that access can be granted consistently through reusable role definitions.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a roleCode, name and scope, when I create a role, then (scope,roleCode) is enforced unique | Given a role is flagged as a protected system role, when a deletion is attempted, then the deletion is rejected as unsafe | Given the role's permission bundle changes, then the role version increments and a RolesUpdated event is published

Summary: Maintain the fine-grained permission catalog
Description: As a Security Admin, I want to manage an immutable-once-used catalog of resource/action permissions so that role bundles reference a stable, auditable permission taxonomy.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a permissionCode, resource and action, when I create a permission, then permissionCode uniqueness is enforced and it is indexed by (resource,action) | Given a permissionCode is already referenced by a role binding, when a change to that code is attempted, then the change is rejected because codes are immutable once used

Summary: Grant and revoke a scoped role binding without privilege escalation
Description: As a Security Admin, I want to bind roles to administrators at a specific tenant/scope with an effective date range so that access grants are time-bound and least-privilege.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a principalId, roleId and scope, when I create a binding, then (tenantId,principalId,roleId,scope) uniqueness is enforced | Given a binding would grant privileges beyond the requester's own authorization policy, when it is submitted, then it is rejected as privilege escalation | Given effectiveTo passes, then the binding is no longer treated as active for authorization decisions

Summary: Run a periodic privileged access review with separation of duties
Description: As a Security Admin, I want to initiate and track periodic access certification reviews so that privileged access is regularly re-validated and unauthorized self-certification is prevented.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a due access review, when I POST /api/v1/admin/access/reviews, then a review record is created with a unique reviewId and dueAt | Given the reviewer is the same principal as the access being reviewed and policy forbids self-certification, when a decision is submitted, then it is rejected | Given the review is completed, then decision and completedAt are recorded and an Access ReviewsCompleted event is published | Given reviews are queried by (tenantId,dueAt,status), then overdue reviews are identifiable for escalation

Summary: Commercial & Usage
Description: Manage the commercial plan catalog, tenant subscription lifecycle, invoicing, payment gateway reconciliation and usage metering as owned by ADM01_subscription_plans, ADM01_subscriptions, ADM01_invoices, ADM01_billing_gateway_transactions and ADM01_usage_metrics.

Summary: Publish an immutable commercial plan
Description: As a Finance/Billing Admin, I want to define and publish subscription plans with pricing and entitlements so that tenants can subscribe to a stable, auditable commercial offering.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a planCode, billingCycle, price, currency and entitlements, when I create a plan, then all financial values are validated for correctness before persistence | Given a plan is published, when a change to that published version is attempted, then it is rejected because published plans are immutable | Given a new plan version is required, then it is created as a new version rather than mutating the published one

Summary: Manage a tenant's subscription lifecycle
Description: As a Finance/Billing Admin, I want to create, renew and change a tenant's subscription so that entitlements and seat counts stay aligned with the commercial agreement.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a planId, when I create a subscription, then the plan reference is validated to exist and be active | Given a subscription status transition (e.g., ACTIVE to RENEWED/CANCELLED), then the transition is captured with full audit detail and a SubscriptionChanged event is published | Given entitlementSnapshot is set at transition time, then it reflects the plan's entitlements at that point, independent of later plan changes

Summary: Issue and manage invoices with controlled post-issue adjustments
Description: As a Finance/Billing Admin, I want to generate invoices for a subscription period and control any post-issue adjustments so that billing amounts remain accurate and auditable.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a subscription and billing period, when an invoice is issued, then invoiceNo is generated and subtotal/tax/total are computed and persisted | Given an invoice has status ISSUED, when a direct amount edit is attempted, then it is rejected unless routed through a controlled adjustment workflow | Given invoices are listed via GET /api/v1/admin/billing/invoices, then results are filterable by tenant and status

Summary: Reconcile payment gateway transactions idempotently
Description: As a Finance/Billing Admin, I want gateway payment callbacks processed idempotently and without storing card data so that billing reconciliation is accurate even under retried webhook deliveries.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a gatewayTransactionId already processed, when the same callback is redelivered, then it is recognized as a duplicate and no double-reconciliation occurs | Given a transaction callback is received, then no card or payment-instrument data is persisted, only rawReference and status | Given a transaction reconciles successfully, then a BillingTransactionReconciled event is published linking back to the invoice

Summary: Calculate and expose tenant usage metrics
Description: As a Finance/Billing Admin, I want tenant usage counters calculated per period so that quotas, analytics and usage-based billing have a reliable, rebuildable source of truth.
Acceptance Criteria: Given raw usage events for a period, when metrics are calculated, then the result is stored as append/aggregate records that can be rebuilt if source data is reprocessed | Given usage metrics are queried via GET /api/v1/admin/usage, then results can be filtered by tenantId, metricType and period | Given a UsageMetricCalculated event is published, then downstream billing and reporting consumers can update projections

Summary: Operations & Analytics
Description: Monitor platform component health and manage operational alerts as owned by ADM01_platform_health and ADM01_alerts.

Summary: Capture platform component health snapshots
Description: As Platform Ops, I want component health and SLO signals recorded on an ongoing basis so that platform reliability can be observed without exposing business or PII data.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a component reports status, latencyMs, errorRate and dependencies, when a health snapshot is recorded, then only operational data is stored with no business PII | Given health snapshots are queried by component and region, then the latest observedAt state is retrievable for dashboards

Summary: Raise, acknowledge and resolve deduplicated operational alerts
Description: As Platform Ops, I want alerts raised with severity and scope, and duplicate alerts automatically deduplicated, so that the on-call team can act on a clean, trustworthy alert stream.
Acceptance Criteria: Given an alert condition fires, when a new alert would duplicate an already-open alert for the same source/scope, then it is deduplicated rather than creating a second record | Given an alert is acknowledged, then acknowledgedAt and assignee are recorded and the status transitions accordingly | Given an alert is resolved, then resolvedAt is recorded, the state transition is controlled by the alert lifecycle, and an AlertsUpdated event is published

Summary: Data Governance
Description: Manage data retention rules, the platform data classification taxonomy, and controlled/authorized data export requests as owned by ADM01_data_retention_policies, ADM01_data_classifications and ADM01_export_requests.

Summary: Define retention rules that cannot undercut legal minimums
Description: As a Security Admin, I want to define data retention policies by data class, tenant and collection so that data is retained and purged consistently with legal and institutional requirements.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a policyCode, dataClass, retentionDays and legalHoldBehavior, when I create/update a policy, then a request to set retentionDays below the legal/institutional minimum is rejected | Given archiveAfterDays is configured, then records are eligible for archival at that threshold ahead of retentionDays | Given the policy changes, then the new version is published and a Data Retention PoliciesUpdated event is emitted

Summary: Maintain a versioned, audited data classification taxonomy
Description: As a Security Admin, I want to define and version data classification levels with handling and export rules so that sensitive data is consistently identified and protected across the platform.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a classCode, sensitivity, handlingRules and exportRules, when a classification is created or changed, then the change is versioned and captured in the audit trail | Given a classification is referenced by other collections' Security/Classification fields, then changing its exportRules affects future export authorization decisions

Summary: Request and approve a controlled data export
Description: As an Institute Admin, I want to request a data export with a defined scope and format so that data can be extracted for legitimate purposes under authorization and time-bound access.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a dataScope, format and purpose, when I POST /api/v1/admin/exports, then the request requires authorization before status can move to APPROVED | Given an export lacks an expiry, when it is submitted, then it is rejected because expiresAt is mandatory | Given an export is approved, then the output objectRef and checksum are recorded and an ExportRequested/Completed event is published | Given expiresAt passes, then the exported object is no longer accessible through the platform

Summary: Audit & Compliance
Description: Maintain the immutable, tamper-evident platform governance and administrative audit trail as owned by ADM01_audit_logs.

Summary: Record an immutable, tamper-evident audit entry for every privileged operation
Description: As a Security Admin, I want every privileged administrative action to write an append-only, tamper-evident audit record so that platform governance actions are fully traceable and cannot be altered after the fact.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a privileged write occurs, when the transaction commits, then an ADM01_audit_logs record is written atomically with actorId, action, resourceType/Id, beforeHash and afterHash | Given an audit record exists, when any modification or deletion is attempted, then it is rejected because the collection is append-only | Given beforeHash/afterHash are computed, then any tampering with historical records is detectable

Summary: Investigate administrative activity via correlated audit search
Description: As a Security Admin, I want to search audit logs by actor, resource and correlationId so that I can investigate incidents and reconstruct the full chain of a governed transaction.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a correlationId from an event or API response, when I search audit logs by that correlationId, then all related audit entries across the transaction chain are returned | Given a date range and actorId, then matching audit entries are returned ordered by occurredAt

Summary: Workflow & Reliability
Description: Manage long-running administrative workflow state and the transactional messaging reliability layer (idempotency, outbox, inbox, dead-letter) as owned by ADM01_workflow_instances, ADM01_idempotency_records, ADM01_outbox_events, ADM01_inbox_events and ADM01_dead_letter_events.

Summary: Run a long-running administrative approval workflow with timeout and retry
Description: As Platform Ops, I want multi-step administrative approval workflows tracked as explicit state machines with timeout and retry rules so that long-running approvals complete reliably or are surfaced for intervention.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a workflowType and subject, when a workflow instance is started, then its steps and state are tracked from startedAt through completedAt | Given a step times out, then the configured retry/timeout rule executes rather than the workflow silently stalling | Given the workflow completes, then an AdministrativeWorkflowCompleted event is published

Summary: Guarantee exactly-once processing of retried admin commands
Description: As Platform Ops, I want retried commands and callbacks deduplicated via idempotency keys so that repeated client or gateway retries never apply a business effect twice.
Acceptance Criteria: Given an idempotencyKey and operation, when the same key is replayed with an identical request hash, then the original responseRef is returned without reapplying the operation | Given the same idempotencyKey is replayed with a different request hash, then the request is rejected as a conflicting duplicate | Given expiresAt passes, then the idempotency record is eligible for cleanup without affecting already-completed operations

Summary: Publish domain events transactionally via the outbox
Description: As Platform Ops, I want domain-state changes and their corresponding events persisted in the same transaction via an outbox so that published events never diverge from committed state.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a business transaction commits, when the outbox record is written, then it is written atomically with the business change in the same transaction | Given the publisher retries a not-yet-confirmed outbox event, then publication is idempotent and does not create duplicate downstream effects | Given publishedAt is set, then retryCount and status reflect the delivery outcome for observability

Summary: Consume inbound events exactly once via the inbox
Description: As Platform Ops, I want consumed events deduplicated via an inbox so that redelivered upstream events (CollegeCreated, billing callbacks, security/IAM events) never reapply their business effect twice.
Acceptance Criteria: Given an eventId already recorded as processed for a consumer, when the same event is redelivered, then it is recognized as a duplicate and no business effect is reapplied | Given processing fails, then status and error are recorded so the event can be retried or investigated

Summary: Review and authorize replay of dead-lettered events
Description: As Platform Ops, I want unrecoverable events routed to a restricted-access dead-letter store so that failures are visible for review and can only be replayed under controlled authorization.
Acceptance Criteria: Given an event exhausts its retry policy, when it fails permanently, then it is written to ADM01_dead_letter_events with failureCode and retryCount | Given a dead-lettered event is queried, then access is restricted to authorized operational roles | Given a replay is requested, then it requires explicit controlled authorization and is captured in the disposition field and audit trail
